decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Proposed Elevations (drawing no.: GA304, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Section (drawing no.: GA305, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Detail A &amp; B (drawing no.: GA305, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Elevations (drawing no.: GA304, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Roof Plan (drawing no.: GA303, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Ground Floor Plan (drawing no.: GA302, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Section AA (drawing no.: GA206, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Existing and Proposed Location Plan (drawing no.: GA300, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Existing and Proposed Side Elevations C+D (drawing no.: GA205, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Existing and Proposed Front Elevation (drawing no.: GA204, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Existing and Proposed Rear Elevation A (drawing no.: GA203, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed Loft Layout Plan (drawing no.: GA202, dated: July 2025)</li><li>Proposed First Floor Plan (drawing no.: GA201, dated: July 2025)</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
description: Construction of a rear dormer extension including three roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation and construction of a single storey rear outbuilding
